days.title: Arrival & Historic Old Town Discovery
days.morning: Arrival, check into eco-certified accommodation, and unpack. Grab a zero-waste morning coffee and map at a local plant-based cafe.
days.afternoon: Join a community-led walking or cycling tour through the historic quarters, visiting heritage plazas and architectural landmarks.
days.evening: Dine at a family-run farm-to-table bistro showcasing seasonal regional specialties. Take a slow evening stroll along the illuminated riverside or pedestrian promenade.
days.transit_tip: 🚆 Purchase an unlimited 3-to-5 day municipal transit pass or rent a city bicycle.

days.title: Arts, Cultural Immersion & Artisan Markets
days.morning: Explore local artisan and farmers' markets. Sample freshly baked sourdough, regional cheeses, and seasonal fruits directly from growers.
days.afternoon: Visit world-class independent museums, community galleries, or traditional craft workshops supporting local heritage preservation.
days.evening: Enjoy dinner at an organic vegetarian restaurant followed by an acoustic concert or open-air theatrical performance.
days.transit_tip: 🚶 Walk between neighbourhood sights; average ~12,000 steps replaces ~3.2 kg car CO2e.

days.title: Urban Nature, Botanical Green Spaces & Parks
days.morning: Cycle to the city's largest botanical gardens, urban food forest, or scenic waterfront park for a refreshing morning nature walk.
days.afternoon: Pack a zero-waste picnic with market produce. Rent a solar-powered electric boat or kayak for a low-impact waterway exploration.
days.evening: Sunset viewing from an elevated green panoramic viewpoint, followed by dinner at a zero-waste certified eatery.
days.transit_tip: 🚲 Use dedicated municipal bike lanes with bike-share or e-bike rental.

days.title: Day Trip to Surrounding Nature Reserve or Eco-Village
days.morning: Take an electric regional train to nearby nature reserves, coastal cliffs, or sustainable vineyard/orchard cooperative.
days.afternoon: Guided biodiversity nature hike with a local park ranger or participate in a sustainable cooking/wine tasting masterclass.
days.evening: Return via train and enjoy casual street-food dining at a vibrant covered market hall.
days.transit_tip: 🚆 Regional rail offers scenic landscapes with 85% lower carbon footprint than driving.

days.title: Hidden Gems, Slow Living & Farewell Sunset
days.morning: Wander through quiet residential neighbourhoods, vintage bookshops, and zero-waste refill boutiques.
days.afternoon: Relax at an eco-wellness spa (thermal mineral baths or natural salt sauna) or attend a pottery workshop.
days.evening: Celebratory farewell dinner at a Michelin Green Star or slow-food restaurant reflecting on your sustainable journey.
days.transit_tip: 🚊 Hop on electric tram lines for a smooth, scenic cross-town return to your stay.

days.title: Iconic Sights on Foot & Le Marais Green Walk
days.morning: Arrive at Gare du Nord / Gare de Lyon via Eurostar/TGV. Check into eco-hotel in 11th arrondissement. Morning croissant at organic bakery.
days.afternoon: Walking exploration of Le Marais, Place des Vosges, and the historic courtyards. Discover zero-waste concept stores on Rue Charlot.
days.evening: Plant-forward gourmet dinner at Le Potager de Charlotte or natural wine bistro in Canal Saint-Martin.
days.transit_tip: 🚲 Rent a Vélib' bike or use Paris Metro lines (100% electrified).

days.title: Artistic Masterpieces & Floating Electric Seine Cruise
days.morning: Musée de l'Orangerie or Musée d'Orsay to admire Monet's Water Lilies and impressionist masterpieces.
days.afternoon: Stroll through the Jardin des Tuileries, crossing Pont des Arts to the Latin Quarter and Shakespeare & Co.
days.evening: Electric solar-powered Seine river cruise at twilight, followed by dinner at Marché des Enfants Rouges.
days.transit_tip: 🚶 Stroll the Seine pedestrianised riverbanks (Rives de Seine).

days.title: Urban Agriculture, Belleville Views & Green Oasis
days.morning: Explore Coulée Verte René-Dumont — a lush 4.7 km elevated parkway built on a historic railway line.
days.afternoon: Visit the community gardens and vibrant street art of Belleville; panoramic view of Paris from Parc de Belleville.
days.evening: Farm-to-fork dinner at Michelin Green Star Septime or Septime La Cave for organic biodynamic pairings.
days.transit_tip: 🚊 Take Metro line 11 and electric bus line 69 across central Paris.

days.title: Palaces, Forests & Sustainable Day Trip to Fontainebleau
days.morning: Catch the 40-minute Transilien R train to Fontainebleau-Avon. Rent a bicycle near the station.
days.afternoon: Cycle and hike through the UNESCO Fontainebleau Biosphere Reserve ancient sandstone forest and chateau grounds.
days.evening: Return to Paris for casual organic crepes and Breton cider in Montparnasse.
days.transit_tip: 🚆 Transilien train journey produces less than 0.8 kg CO2 per passenger.

days.title: Montmartre's Secret Vineyards & Farewell Rooftop Sunset
days.morning: Early morning walk up the quiet backstreets of Montmartre, visiting the historic Clos Montmartre organic vineyard.
days.afternoon: Browse second-hand vintage boutiques along Rue des Martyrs and visit the sustainable fashion hub La Caserne.
days.evening: Sunset from the terrace of Parc des Buttes-Chaumont followed by farewell dinner at Aujourd'hui Demain.
days.transit_tip: 🚶 Take the Montmartre funicular with standard Metro ticket or climb the scenic stairways.

days.title: River Thames Green Corridor & Borough Market
days.morning: Arrival at St Pancras International via Eurostar. Check into eco-hotel in Southwark. Fair-trade coffee near the river.
days.afternoon: Walk the car-free South Bank path from Westminster Bridge to London Bridge, stopping at the free Tate Modern gallery.
days.evening: Dine around Borough Market sampling zero-waste hot dishes, British organic cheeses, and local sourdough.
days.transit_tip: 🚆 Tap in/out with contactless payment on TfL buses, Tube, and Thames Clippers.

days.title: Regent's Canal Towpath Cycling & Camden Green Hub
days.morning: Santander Cycles rental along the scenic Regent's Canal towpath from Paddington basin to King's Cross Coal Drops Yard.
days.afternoon: Explore Camden Lock craft stalls, organic vegan bakeries, and panoramic views from top of Primrose Hill.
days.evening: Dinner at Mildreds Soho or Rovi vegetable-forward dining in Fitzrovia.
days.transit_tip: 🚲 Follow Quietway cycle routes (CS6 and Regent's Canal).

days.title: Ancient Woodland, Hampstead Heath & Wild Swimming
days.morning: Overground train to Hampstead Heath. Hike to Parliament Hill for sweeping city skyline panoramas.
days.afternoon: Eco dip in Hampstead mixed bathing pond (natural rainwater lake) and visit Kenwood House heritage estate.
days.evening: Traditional historic pub dinner with locally brewed cask ales at The Holly Bush (18th-century landmark).
days.transit_tip: 🚊 London Overground train network connects green suburban commons.

days.title: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew — UNESCO Biodiversity Center
days.morning: District line tube to Kew Gardens — world's most biodiverse living plant collection and Temperate House.
days.afternoon: Walk the Treetop Walkway 18 meters above ground and explore the Millennium Seed Bank conservation initiative.
days.evening: Return to West London; dinner at an organic gastro-pub in Richmond upon Thames.
days.transit_tip: 🚆 Direct 30-min tube or South Western Railway from Waterloo.

days.title: Greenwich Maritime & Royal Observatory Parkland
days.morning: Uber Boat by Thames Clippers (hybrid electric vessel) cruise down the river to Greenwich Pier.
days.afternoon: Explore Greenwich Royal Park, Prime Meridian line (Longitude 0°), and zero-carbon craft stalls at Greenwich Market.
days.evening: Sunset picnic on Observatory hill and farewell dinner in Bermondsey beer mile micro-eateries.
days.transit_tip: ⛵ Hybrid Thames Clipper river ferry offers scenic travel with reduced emissions.

days.title: Berlin Wall History & Spree River Bike Tour
days.morning: Arrive at Berlin Hauptbahnhof (Europe's largest solar-powered hub). Check into eco-hotel in Friedrichshain. Coffee at Silo.
days.afternoon: Cycle along the East Side Gallery and Oberbaumbrücke into Kreuzberg's vibrant canal paths.
days.evening: Street food dinner at Markthalle Neun or zero-waste dining at world-famous Frea.
days.transit_tip: 🚲 Rent a Donkey Republic bike with unlimited day pass.

days.title: Tempelhof Field & Community Urban Gardens
days.morning: Explore Tempelhofer Feld — a massive 355-hectare decommissioned airport turned public park and wildlife corridor.
days.afternoon: Visit Prinzessinnengärten nomadic community urban garden; join a guided workshop on urban biodiversity.
days.evening: Enjoy artisan vegan pizza at Sfizy Veg or craft beer at BRLO Brwhouse (built from upcycled shipping containers).
days.transit_tip: 🚊 U-Bahn line U8 and U6 with BVG 24-hour AB ticket.

days.title: UNESCO Museum Island & Tiergarten Green Lung
days.morning: Explore Museum Island (Neues Museum and Pergamon panorama).
days.afternoon: Walk or cycle through the expansive Tiergarten to the iconic glass dome of the Reichstag (powered by renewable bio-oil).
days.evening: Multi-course seasonal plant tasting dinner at Kopps in Mitte.
days.transit_tip: 🚶 Berlin's wide pedestrian tree-lined boulevards are ideal for walking.

days.title: Day Trip to Potsdam Palaces & Havelland Lakes
days.morning: S-Bahn S7 to Potsdam (30 mins). Rent a bike at Potsdam Hauptbahnhof.
days.afternoon: Cycle through Sanssouci Palace organic gardens, Dutch Quarter, and along the scenic Havel river lakes.
days.evening: Return to Berlin for craft cider and organic snacks in Prenzlauer Berg.
days.transit_tip: 🚆 S-Bahn line S7 with ABC zone ticket.

days.title: Zero-Waste Shopping & Farewell Lake Sunset
days.morning: Visit Original Unverpackt (pioneering zero-waste package-free supermarket) and Mauerpark flea market.
days.afternoon: Take S-Bahn to Schlachtensee or Müggelsee for a refreshing natural lake swim and forest walk.
days.evening: Farewell rooftop dinner at Klunkerkranich eco-cultural community rooftop garden in Neukölln.
days.transit_tip: 🚊 Tram M10 and M1 connecting Friedrichshain and Prenzlauer Berg.
